instruction: Implement an adder-subtractor module that performs arithmetic operations on two 32-bit inputs, a and b, based on the value of the sub input. Use two 16-bit ripple carry adder modules and a 32-bit wide XOR gate to achieve this. Connect the sub input to the carry-in of the first adder, and use the XOR gate to invert the b input when sub is high. Finally, combine the outputs of the two adders to generate the final 32-bit sum output.
